strings: #01It's Ben Franklin!
Sir! The British are coming!
We need to get you out of the city before they arrive!
We've chartered the last carriage out of town. We'll cover your escape!
The English may burn our cities, but they can't burn our desire for freedom!
#1*Single-Shot Firelock: Press 5 to grab and press 5 to shoot.
#04My knee... it's hurt...
Hold on, sir. I'll try to find help!
#1*General Washington isn't going anywhere. Neither of you are!
Who's there?!
#0*My name is Hickey and I'll be escorting you both to the great beyond!
#0*Now, let's finish this little meet and greet, shall we?
#0*You fool! You can't stop me!
#04Seems you've saved me again. Perhaps you should be General, eh?
#11My home is in the shadows.
#04The Redcoats have this place surrounded, but there's a secret door. We can use it to sneak by them undetected.
For my country!
#01I've found it. Can you walk?
#04I'll manage. Now go! You've got more work to do.
Oh, hello. Nice of you to drop in. I'd offer you tea, but I'm currently a hostage.
#11I took out the guards. You're free to leave.
Thank you! You're a hero and a true patriot!
\0New York City#September, 1776
Help! They're burning everything!
Washington is in danger! The Redcoats trapped him in the old church.
#11Don't worry. I'll rescue him.
I hope so. Good luck.
#01You are free, senator.
Connor!
Are you OK?
#01Never better...
#04The door is blocked! I can't open it.
#01Haytham is outside. He'll protect you.
#01I know the way out!
#1*Take down Hickey before he reaches Washington!
#15The man will join your guild later.
